snippet.title: The Magician's Challenge | Game Trailer
snippet.description:
It will be a real challenge to escape from this magical room full of puzzles!
Can you solve the biggest-kept secret of the magicians? You are a magician in training about to take your final test.
In this relaxed point-and-click adventure you will discover a magical room. In this room a series of puzzles can be found that need to be solved to find the key, which opens the door so you can escape.
Expect enjoyment and challenging puzzles in which you need creative solutions to escape the library. How fast can you escape?

Buy The Magician's Challenge on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4216340/The_Magicians_Challenge/ 
Buy The Magician's Challenge on itch.io: https://esciri.itch.io/the-magicians-challenge
